name.en: Billing cycle: invoice, collection, arrears, penalty, waiver
name.hi: बिलिंग चक्र: बीजक, संग्रह, बकाया, दंड, माफ़ी

description: Per cycle (timer or message) the account register is loaded and one case per account runs (GP-09): invoice from the tenant tariff (slabs, fixed, percentage, DMN), demand raised in the receivable ledger, wait for the payment or the due date; payment is collected and receipted; after the due date arrears are checked, the penalty / interest of the tariff is levied, a reminder goes out, and an officer decides waiver / write-off (maker-checker) or continued recovery. Neutral to government or sector.

connectors.purpose: Record a confirmed payment and receipt
Outstanding and arrears of the account
